subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Unit economics deep-dive & pricing follow-up

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and a few follow-ups so we can prepare the unit-economics deep-dive: 

Key points we heard on the call:
- Product surface: 3 user-facing features that call LLM for short completions (avg 75 tokens) and 1 background enrichment job (avg 250 tokens).
- Expected volume: pilot ~5M tokens/month ramping to 50M tokens/month over 6 months (mobile web + backend).
- SLA: 200ms p95 for interactive flows, background jobs can be batch.
- Security: must run in VPC-enabled Private deployment for PII data (discussed with security).

Open questions for the deep-dive (please confirm):
1) Monthly token range for contract sizing: is 5–10M (pilot) -> target 40–60M realistic?
2) Target total spend / month or budget range (e.g., $X–$Y) you have in mind for inference?
3) Unit economics targets: are you thinking in terms of $/1M tokens, or $/feature-per-month? Any internal target $/1M tokens?
4) CAC / payback expectations — do you have an LTV:CAC or months-to-payback goal we should align pricing to?

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm the above, we’ll prepare a short delta analysis: projected $/1M tokens for hosted vs dedicated vs private, plus estimated $/feature and margin impact at your target volumes.
- Schedule a 45-minute unit-econ deep-dive next week to walk the spreadsheet and options.

I attached our pricing deck and a template CSV you can drop your actual usage into — will make the numbers concrete.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: Redwood_pricing_deck.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: usage_template.csv (CSV, 8KB)

From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive & pricing follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers are in the right ballpark. A few clarifications: 
- Pilot: we’re comfortable validating at 5–8M tokens/mo for the first 6 weeks.
- Target: our modelling shows production could land around 45–55M tokens/mo by month 6 if retention/activation hits targets.
- Budget: rough internal target is $8k–$20k/mo for inference during pilot -> we’d expect an increase to ~$60k–$120k/mo at scale depending on performance/latency.
- Unit target: we typically think in $/1M tokens; our finance team is looking for guidance around $/1M that maps to $/feature.
- CAC/payback: at the moment we’re targeting <6 months payback on incremental features (LTV:CAC ~3:1).

We’ll drop the real usage CSV in shortly (attached). Can we do the deep-dive Thursday 2/12 9:00am PT?

Cheers,
Alice
Head of Product, FintechX
alice.tan@fintechx.com
Attachment: FintechX_usage_export.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive & pricing follow-up

Thanks Alice — that schedule works. I’ve attached the pricing deck (v2) and a short spreadsheet that maps your 3 interactive features + 1 enrichment job into $/feature and overall margin at different price points. High-level previews below so we can use the call to iterate on assumptions: 

Assumptions we’ll bring to the call (can adjust live):
- Avg token per interactive feature call: 75 tokens; avg calls per user/month: 4 (feature A/B/C aggregated)
- Enrichment job: 250 tokens per record, ~2000 records/day (batchable)
- Conversion and CAC: assume $120 CAC for users acquired from feature-driven channels (we’ll vary this)

Example unit-econ outputs (rough, to be refined on call):
- $/1M tokens (hosted API baseline): $450–$550 per 1M tokens (depends on batching / KV cache effectiveness)
- $/1M tokens (dedicated reserved): $300–$380 per 1M tokens at 50M+/mo committed
- $/feature (interactive): at 75 tokens/call, 4 calls/user/mo -> ~300 tokens/user/mo -> at $400 per 1M tokens = $0.12 per active user/month in inference cost for the feature
- CAC payback: with $120 CAC, feature-inference cost of $0.12/user/mo implies 6 months inference cost = $0.72 — clearly CAC is dominated by acquisition, not inference; but gross margins shrink if inference spends scale non-linearly.

Questions for the call where we’ll need your input:
- Acceptable margin targets vs inference: do you target 60% gross margin on features, or is there a different benchmark?
- Any strong requirement to avoid hosted bursts (preference for Dedicated/Private)?

Proposed agenda for 2/12 9:00am PT (45m):
1) Walk FintechX CSV + correct volumes
2) Live model: show $/1M tokens across deployment modes + $/feature mapping
3) Trade-offs: latency vs cost, batching & cache strategies, quantization impact
4) Next steps & contracting options (pilot pricing, committed capacity)

Call invite: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/fintechx-unit-econ-021226

Talk soon —
Marissa
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

- Please confirm whether FintechX is open to a 6–12 month committed Dedicated pilot at 50M/mo with a step-down price — that gives us real $/1M leverage to hit the lower band ($300–380).

I’ll join the deep-dive and bring the finance side to articulate margin sensitivity.
